description: SQL-DEMAND, deciding variant: the same failing row (Bad: z = 0 at id 3 of 5) read through a saved QueryDef instead of a direct statement. Saved queries QPlain (id, 1/z), QWhere (WHERE 1/z > 0), QSort (ORDER BY id DESC), QGroup (Sum(1/z)), QTop2 (TOP 2 ... ORDER BY id, cutoff before the bad row), QTop4 (TOP 4, cutoff after it) and QXtab (TRANSFORM ... PIVOT 1/z) are created and each opened with QueryDef.OpenRecordset as a snapshot; the open, every row's Value reads and the movements are captured. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-DEMAND, R-PAR-1, PAR-ERROR; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
